responsibility: Core implementation of C++ template processing and instantiation. It manages template parameter levels and specialization tables, template argument substitution and conversion, deduction/unification, parameter-pack discovery and expansion, pending instantiations, partial specialization lookup, local specialization scopes, implicit template machinery, and many of the algorithms that turn dependent template patterns into instantiated declarations, types, statements, and expressions. This is the main file for failures involving tsubst-style substitution, template argument matching, auto/noexcept/lambda instantiation behavior, and delayed instantiation state rather than ordinary non-template type checking.
